provenance_note: Multi-sign permit submittal. All client, property-owner, vendor, salesperson, designer, and contact data excluded at extraction. Names, emails, phones, order number, and street addresses stripped. Industrial business-park vertical retained; tenant copy excluded, copy structure retained.

program_model.instance_model: one re-skin technique applied at several sizes/locations across the park (primary monument type 1, secondary monument type 2, and type 3B units); identical construction approach, different size and copy

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A retrofit that re-skins existing concrete monument signs with a new fabricated aluminum cabinet/face frame, painted dark satin and decorated with applied white vinyl copy and a tenant/owner logo. New aluminum tube-and-angle framing bolts to the existing concrete monument and carries the new face, modernizing the sign without demolishing the masonry. Non-illuminated.
knowledge.rationale: Re-skinning reuses the existing concrete mass and footing, so the park gets a consistent updated identity at lower cost and permitting burden than tearing out and rebuilding each monument.
knowledge.tradeoffs: Re-skinning is economical and fast but is constrained by the existing monument's size and proportions, and depends on sound existing concrete to bolt to.
knowledge.when_to_use: Repositioning or rebranding a property that already has structurally sound concrete monuments worth keeping.

structure.function: reused structural base (existing, not in fabrication scope)
structure.construction: existing concrete monument sign; new work bolts to it

structure.function: new face/cabinet re-skinning the existing monument
structure.construction: fabricated aluminum face on a frame of 2x2x1/8in aluminum tube, 1-1/2x1-1/2x1/8in and 2x2x1/8in aluminum angle, and 2x2x1/8in aluminum channel; 2x2x1/8in aluminum 'C' channel reveal; heavy-duty extruded aluminum and 2x2x3/16in aluminum tube
structure.mounted_via: aluminum tube bottom-bolted to existing concrete monument

materials_manifest.product: fabricated aluminum face, tube, angle, and channel framing
Matthews satin, color-matched to Sherwin-Williams SW7069 Iron Ore
3M high-performance vinyl, applied copy and logo

dimensions.note: Sizes vary by instance (primary larger than secondary); exact cabinet dimensions per the elevation pages, carried at medium confidence from extraction. Permit set carries full material/finish codes (R3: high completeness).

copy_blocks.treatment: primary white vinyl wordmark on dark face

rules_observations: Single dark face with high-contrast white copy gives one clear daytime read across the park.
Consistent face color and copy system across primary/secondary/3B units holds family consistency.
craft_observations: A 'C' channel reveal detail gives the re-skin a shadow line so it reads as a designed cabinet rather than a panel slapped on the old monument.
Reusing the existing concrete base is a pragmatic, material-honest move when the masonry is sound.

aesthetic_notes.note: Restrained industrial identity (dark face, white type, minimal logo); appropriate to a business park rather than expressive.

open_items: Condition/adequacy of existing concrete monuments to receive new bolted framing assumed, not verified on this set

extraction_meta.field_confidence: high on construction, framing, and finish codes (permit completeness); medium on exact per-instance dimensions
extraction_meta.reconciliation_v1_2: fabrication_family -> cabinet (dominant construction: fabricated aluminum face/cabinet); reskin specificity in sub_type. Cleared to records/.
